payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate all possible digit sums i from 0 to 89, set x = n-i, verify if digit sum of x equals i, and collect valid x.
payload.rationale: The code performs a simple linear scan over a small parameter (digit sum) rather than classic backtracking. However, among the provided subtypes, search_backtracking is the most general complete search category, as others (bitmask, branch-and-bound, graph, permutation) clearly do not apply.
